description: This file is a plugin for CKEditor that adds and manages style functionalities, including style registration, application, removal, and configuration within the editor.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.style
classes.description: Represents a style with methods to apply, remove, and check style properties.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.styleCommand
classes.description: Command class to execute style application or removal.

methods.name: attachStyleStateChange
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called when a style's active state changes.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the style to a given document or range.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the style from a given document or range.

methods.name: applyToRange
methods.description: Applies the style to a specified range.

methods.name: removeFromRange
methods.description: Removes the style from a specified range.

methods.name: checkActive
methods.description: Checks if the style is active in a given element path.

methods.name: buildPreview
methods.description: Builds HTML preview of the style.
